statement: $ABCD$ is a convex quadrilateral for which $AB$ is the longest side. Points $M$ and $N$ are located on sides $AB$ and $BC$ respectively, so that each of the segments $AN$ and $CM$ divides the quadrilateral into two parts of equal area. Prove that the segment $MN$ bisects the diagonal $BD$.

Determine all functions $f$ defined on the set of rational numbers that take rational values for which
$$f(2f(x) + f(y)) = 2x + y$$
for all rational $x$ and $y$.

Let $a, b, c$ be positive real numbers with $a + b + c = 1$. Prove that
$$\frac{a - bc}{a + bc} + \frac{b - ca}{b + ca} + \frac{c - ab}{c + ab} \leq \frac{3}{2}.$$

Determine all functions $f$ defined on the natural numbers taking values among the natural numbers for which
$$(f(n))^p \equiv n \pmod{f(p)}$$
for all $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and all prime numbers $p$.

A self-avoiding rook walk on a chessboard is a path traced by a sequence of moves parallel to an edge of the board, such that each move begins where the previous ended and no square is crossed more than once. Let $R(m, n)$ be the number of self-avoiding rook walks on an $m \times n$ board beginning at the lower-left corner and ending at the upper-left corner. Find a formula for $R(3, n)$ for each natural number $n$.
